steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: A Blue Rain warning has been issued. It's going to rain soon, Chief.
You look up. He's right, the sky is overcast. You can faintly hear the distant rumble of thunder.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Let's speed up and try to reach our destination before it starts raining.

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: Got it.
Since you visited Conrad Cage two days ago, you've been looking for the evidence he mentioned.

steps.speaker: Arrest Team Captain
steps.content: We're here, Chief.
This is an abandoned residence located at the border of Eastside and the Rust. Besides passing vagrants and scavengers, no one else would set foot here.

You enter the room, which is a long-uninhabited apartment. Piles of clutter fill every corner of the room. The dust has mixed with the humid air before the rain, making it a bit difficult for you to breathe.
The footprints and drag marks on the floor are covered with a thin layer of dust. They were probably left by Conrad.
The howling wind blows through the broken window into the room, lifting the curtains and stirring up the dust. With the dim light and dilapidated room, it looks like a scene taken out of a noir film.
You don't wait aimlessly for Rahu to arrive. Instead, you start looking for Conrad's evidence.
A few minutes later, you find a dusty notebook hidden behind a dirty painting on the wall.

April 1
According to the old man in the Drifter Camp, the Rustfire incident followed the exact same track as the incident in N.F. 104. This matches the existing information.
In the incident in March, they manipulated public opinion, incited conflicts, and failed negotiations. Internally, they claimed that Rustfire attacked and killed important officials. Externally, they put the blame on Rustfire through public opinion and media, completely omitting Rustfire's demands and initial attitude. These methods are very similar to those used during the BR-002 outbreak in N.F. 104. They were possibly put forward by the same group of people.
Organizations like the FAC, the Executive Committee, or the MBCC don't have this kind of power. Only Paradeisos is capable of that.

Detailed information is backed up at ██████. File password: ████████████.
This battle will help me learn more.

April 5 The MBCC has lost control. From what I've heard from the Rustfire rioters, that Chief with the shackles has gone missing and has likely died during the riot. No wonder the MBCC didn't come to our aid. I heard all the Sinners have gone manic. The situation in the West District is dire. The Underground runs rampant and fake news is spreading everywhere. I can now confirm that Paradeisos is indeed involved in all this. Is this good news? Probably. And I've heard about an even better opportunity... The FAC is discussing an emergency recruitment of special Sinners. With the MBCC paralyzed, becoming a Sinner now won't get me detained. Instead, I may be able to skip the usual FAC operations and take on higher-level missions. I've waited in this position for too long. I can only get access to so much information as a regular FAC soldier. I must take it a notch higher. This is an opportunity... I can't wait any longer. To move forward, I must take risks.

April 9 Injected Mania Crystal. Waiting for results. April 12 Passed out for three days. My physical reactions were intense, but it was all worth it... I drove back a large group of rioters who attacked the camp and received direct instructions from higher-level management. Conrad cursed for hours. He even cried in the end. Haha... What's he crying for? I can protect him now. From here on out, I can do even more... April 16 The meeting ended. I've been given permission to act freely and I've joined the special task force. I reclaimed several refugee camps, and then received some higher-level missions. They want me to protect the Executive Committee, along with the Nirvana surveyor...

April 29
Attempted to speak with the Nirvana surveyor and was rejected.

May 9
Tried again to get in contact with Nirvana. They're very cautious, so no success.
The battle is too stagnant. Both the Black Ring and the riots are getting out of hand. But in my current position, the information I have access to is dozens of times more than before.

Despite the high confidentiality, the deployment of security forces can still be inferred... More and more Paradeisians are joining the command. If they really have something to do with the Inner Bay Black Ring in N.F. 104, then... they must also be connected to what happened to N.F. 103.
The information dealers on the dark web are not reliable. I should find another channel.

July 18
Several Paradeisian officials have been attacked in Eastside. The FAC receives all kinds of calls for support, all related to Paradeisians, but they are never answered. This is not normal... But I can't find more clues.
This is my only chance to get in touch with Paradeisians. The situation in the West District is cooling down and there have obviously been fewer major missions. The FAC has begun their casualty count too. Those Paradeisians will leave soon. I must act now.

The location is Erica Villa in Eastside, where there's clearly a shortage of guards. They keep asking for support but in vain.
This is an opportunity. If I go now, I won't be rejected like before.

I'll surely come back with more clues this time.
There are no more new clues after that. You silently close the notebook.

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: This is the evidence you collected yourself! You wanted this! The real Rahu wanted this! You went through hell for the truth, and listen to what you're saying now!

steps.speaker: Conrad
steps.content: I shouldn't have let you go to that villa... I shouldn't have let you go alone... What happened there?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Next is my advice to you: Don't overreach yourself. Don't pry into things you shouldn't. Forget whatever he just told you. Otherwise, you will end up like him.
You recall the weird sensation the shackles detected inside her, and the inconsistency between the author of this notebook and her in real life. You try to make out the differences.
But another clear feeling is reminding you that there's no need anymore.
Bang—
After the thunder, the downpour follows as expected.
At the same time, something made of cold, hard metal is pressed against your lower back.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Don't move. Keep your hand still.
Using the thunder as cover, Rahu finally appears behind you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Didn't you say you'd follow the orders of your Commander? Why did you sneak out of the MBCC and then sneak up on me like that?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You didn't heed my advice either. You touched something you shouldn't have.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: How did you escape?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I have my ways.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Don't worry, your people are competent. They've done everything they could.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: What about the people downstairs?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm not a maniac who kills for fun. I just made sure they'd leave me alone for a while.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Good.
Rahu subtly closes in, the tip of her blade pressing against your back.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You don't seem surprised that I came.
Yes, the shackles sensed her arrival a long time ago. You knew she would come, and you were waiting.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: So, you here to kill me?

choices.text: So, you here to kill me?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: That depends on your choices.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Give me what's in your hands and leave. Forget the contents of the notebook and what happened these few days. Go back to being the Chief of the MBCC and mind your own business... Maybe you'll be spared. Who knows?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: What about you? After completing this mission, what are you going to do?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Escape from the MBCC? Return to your master?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: That's none of your business.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: No, that's exactly why I'm here waiting for you.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It wasn't easy for me to find a chance to talk to you alone. You've already cleared all possible eavesdroppers. Now, let's talk about what really happened, Rahu.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The old Rahu that Conrad knew, the person who went to great lengths to seek the truth in this notebook, where did she go? What happened to you after you left Conrad?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Is this another interrogation? You're gonna pry the answer out of me?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You don't have to tell me.

choices.text: You don't have to tell me.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But I will look for it myself. I will find out everything that happened in Erica Villa in July.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I've already crossed the line many times now, and yet I've only been mildly <color=#fb9259>warned</color> by you <color=#fb9259>alone</color>...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Believe me, I'll uncover the truth soon. After all...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: You've always protected me, just like you've protected Conrad.

choices.text: You've always protected me, just like you've protected Conrad.

steps.content: Suddenly, a hand violently grips your neck from behind, almost lifting you off the ground.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Don't push your luck! The only reason I haven't killed you is that I've received no such order. It may not be the case if you go a step further.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: One word from them, and I'll snap your neck instantly.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Everyone around you will then pay the price of your reckless arrogance.
You cough painfully twice and struggle to muster a small laugh, making sure she hears it clearly.

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Like how you dragged Conrad into this?

choices.text: Like how you dragged Conrad into this?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: [CG Farewell Moment B]
You're thrown onto the floor with a painful hit. As you come to your senses, the evidence in your hand is already tightly clenched by its original owner, almost crumpled into a ball.

Rahu clenches her fists, and from beneath the mask comes the suppressed breathing of a cornered animal. She turns her head away from you, and you know she's closing her eyes again, using all her strength to tame her anger.
This time, you won't let her put on her disguise again.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I once thought you were brainwashed or controlled. Now it seems that's not the case. I'm more inclined to believe that someone with that kind of determination wouldn't change so drastically in such a short time.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I've read the notes, and as you've said, there isn't much valuable information.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You were a regular FAC soldier. During those ten years, you obeyed orders and fought in battles. Busy fighting for your life, you couldn't possibly find the opportunity to climb higher and gain more.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Even though you risked your life to become a Sinner and endured the torment of Mania alone, you were only able to advance a small step. You were nothing more than just an FAC soldier, you couldn't go any further.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: So, you decided to take a different path, even if it meant walking alone into the depths of darkness with an iron mask on. Like you do now.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But who do you think you're fooling? The shackles felt it all too clearly. In Conrad's cell, your pain could barely be concealed. You were too eager to protect him.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If Conrad hadn't been struggling with Mania, he would have seen it clearly too. He would have slapped you awake, you stubborn fool.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Enough!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Like you, I have things I must do, and I need to delve into danger to find the truth. I understand your determination, and I understand your instinct to protect others.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: The shackles felt it all too clearly. In Conrad's cell, your pain could barely be concealed. You were too eager to protect him.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...Enough.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I have no intention of protecting Conrad, let alone protecting you.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I'm not that strong, and there's only so much I can do. If they notice you've crossed the line, I don't have a way to keep you alive right now.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: ...There are already people seeking the truth you want, and there will be people to eradicate threats against you in the shadows.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: So... don't cross over. Stay under the sun and don't go any further.
She looks at you, her eyes no longer filled with anger, only an empty sadness.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I think I can understand your determination. But must you shoulder all of this yourself?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: When Conrad... and many others are eager to back you up. I can give you a hand too. Do you insist on going alone even though we're on the same side?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: What is it that you see... Who is this enemy that you fear...
Bang—

Lightning illuminates her face, and the deafening thunder drowns out her response. The wind brings the rain through the shattered window. The torn curtains are drenched in rain, dancing wildly in the wind.
What follows is a gunshot. The bullet whizzes toward the notebook in Rahu's hand. Rahu reacts instantly, blocking the attack.
Rain spatters on her face and red light bounces off her skin. Her face turning vigilant, she instinctively shields you with her own body and bellows.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Who's there?!
Her gaze is directed at the corner of the room, which is pitch dark.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Show yourself!
Under Rahu's stern warning, several figures emerge from the shadow. They are clad in heavy armor, but they make no sound when they suddenly appear in the room.
An acute sense of danger creeps up your brain. You've never seen these people before, but you're certain they're not friends.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: HUSH... What are you doing here?

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: Executing a mission.
The voice of the intruder is cold and mechanical, as if naturally devoid of emotions.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: What mission?

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: Destroy everything related to her, including all those who know.
steps.female_content: L.L.

steps.content: They're staring at the evidence in Rahu's hand.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: This is my mission. And I've already completed it.
Underneath Rahu's detached and terse tone, there lies a strong sense of caution.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: No... you haven't.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: You haven't executed Conrad Cage, and you've let another person in on it.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: You are the source of the intelligence leak. And now you want to hand it over to another outsider.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: <color=#fb9259><size=45>I've never done anything like that!</size></color>
She glances over her shoulder at you, gritting her teeth.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Enough. The longer we talk, the more we're giving away, and the more unnecessary things you'll have to do later.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: This person here saw nothing. I have the evidence. Now, take me back to Paradeisos.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Run as many loyalty tests on me as you want when we're back. As long as it's within my protection range, I can comply.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: No need. The test begins now.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: Eliminate Conrad Cage. Prove your loyalty and reliability.
You see her clench her fists from behind clearly. She's desperately holding back and maintaining her disguise, trying not to expose herself.
But it's becoming clear... You look across and can't help getting a bad feeling.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I said... within the stated range. My role is a guard, I... cannot undertake the responsibility of destruction and harm.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: He's already an enemy of DisCity. Just like the Underground, he's not within your protection range.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: That's not for you to decide. You don't have the authorization to determine this.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: The FAC and the 9th Agency will set up a special investigation team. Are you questioning their reliability on behalf of Paradeisos?
She grits her teeth, uttering these words with distinct pauses. The HUSH soldier stops.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: ...You're right.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: But we have the authorization to get rid of you, a parasite on HUSH.
Those strange puppet voices convey no emotions. They raise their guns.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: Your emotional state has been abnormal and you are highly unstable. As someone who's been marked, you've fallen out of the safe range.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: This is the influence of the shackles. My stability has been affected precisely because of this useless transfer order. Let me go. There's no point in staying here anymore.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: You are a guard chosen and deeply marked by X. During her confinement, you serve as a reference on her condition. Fluctuations in you mean fluctuations in her. Your betrayal means her betrayal.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: As the executors of HUSH, we judge that you and she have become obstacles blocking the system. With the two of you present, the next Hush cannot take over.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: We need the next Hush. So now, HUSH needs to get rid of you first.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: I see... This is your goal... This ridiculous transfer is also your doing...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You sent me here just to set me up. You wanted to use me to remove your obstacles from the very start.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: We don't know about any transfer orders. We serve only Paradeisos and HUSH.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: The Hush position has been vacant for too long. We will find the optimal solution ourselves.
Another flash of lightning cuts through and the muffled thunder shatters the silence. The light illuminates her expression.

It's filled with suppressed rage and you can see all her indignation. She's not ready to give up the path she's endured and erase all her sacrifices. She's still scouring for a solution, one that doesn't require fighting or lifting her disguise.
But Rahu's body has already reacted.
As the guns are pointed at you, a dim halo gathers and revolves above Rahu's armguard. She subconsciously steps back and stands in front of you, assuming a combat stance.
The face masks cover the HUSH soldiers' faces and you can't see their reaction, although you think this is probably going as they wish.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: All your rebellious behaviors just now will be uploaded as surveillance records and serve as evidence of your misconduct.
You go too far, Hush!
A small knife cuts through the silence, stabbing into the shoulder of the leading HUSH elite. That's the weapon Rahu was just pressing against your back.
Unfortunately, you missed. You were aiming for its forehead.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: Chief... of Minos.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I thought you were purposely ignoring me.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: He's...
steps.female_content: She's...

steps.content: You impose a prohibition on her. Sharp spikes of light burst from her body. Caught off guard, she falls to her knees, looking at you incredulously.
You peer at her coldly and deliberately tilt your head up, giving your best performance.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I know you're in cahoots with them, Hush's lackey. Now that you're shackled by me, don't think of defying me.
The HUSH Unit fall silent for a moment, then shift their guns toward you.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: You've already seen things you shouldn't have. Are you sure you want to meddle further in this?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You already did a number on me that time in the West District, remember? I'll let that one slide, since Paradeisos gave the order. I was mad, but I got over it. How am I supposed to tolerate this again?
You speak with righteous indignation, sounding furious.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: This Sinner named Rahu, she's the one Hush has marked, right? Did you see how your lapdog just brazenly attacked me?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: She wants to kill me just because I wanted to understand why I was treated that way and uncover some truth?

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Shut up! You have no idea what you're doing!

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: We'd advise you to speak and act carefully, Chief of Minos. Paradeisos needs you right now, but they need a more cautious and reliable version of you.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: Everything you say and do here will be uploaded as surveillance records. You...

steps.speaker: Choice
options: Being watched is nothing new to me.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: If you guys really had direct instructions from Paradeisos, you wouldn't need to test someone in such a roundabout way.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You act recklessly without your master's orders. If Paradeisos really cared about you, they wouldn't have let HUSH stay abandoned for so long.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Without Hush, you guys can't even be considered as tools, can you? That's why you jump and bite the first person you see desperately.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Listen, Conrad is with me, and I won't hand him over to you. Let the real Paradeisian talk to me, or I'll go to him tomorrow.
The HUSH Unit fall silent, but their guns are still pointed at you.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: Hostility confirmed. Reporting threat. Requesting target elimination. This is your final warning: Watch your words and actions. Don't make Paradeisos question your credibility.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: If we judge that you pose a threat to HUSH, we can eliminate you ourselves. Right now, you cannot defend yourself.

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: Be cautious with your words and actions.
You turn away from those emotionless mannequins. Your gaze shifts to Rahu.
The woman who's been trudging with heavy steps and gone too far to turn back. Now you finally understand her.

At the other end of the shackles, she's blind with the urge to rush over and push you out of this battlefield. You're exhausting all your strength to suppress her impulse so she doesn't cut off her own retreat, even though you know she was born with this protective instinct.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I respect those who are prudent, and when necessary, I will learn from them.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But sometimes, I end up being suspected no matter what I do. So you see, there's no need to worry too much, and I often just follow my heart. I also make sure I clean up the mess I create.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Besides, it's not like there's really big trouble now. I can handle the consequence of swatting a few flies.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Rahu, I've decided I want my revenge now. This is an order from the shackles, you can't say no!

steps.speaker: HUSH
steps.content: Rahu, refuse the order! The shackles can't control you. You obey Paradeisos, Hush, and the system. Kill him now!
steps.female_content: Rahu, refuse the order! The shackles can't control you. You obey Paradeisos, Hush, and the system. Kill her now!

options: Listen to me and take them down!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: They must have everything on record. It's all my doing. I threw a tantrum and forced you to turn against your comrades.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Paradeisos knows me very well. In fact, it'll surprise them more if I don't do this. They'll think I'm up to no good.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Leave the rest to me. It's okay.
You struggle to undo Rahu's armguard and hold her hand. Her mind is being consumed by Mania and rage, and her arms are trembling uncontrollably.

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: You shouldn't have interfered... It's not time yet...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: They're going to make a move. They won't let you off. I can't protect you either...

steps.speaker: Rahu
steps.content: Let me go. Let me go back to Paradeisos... In the end, at least let me...
She can't hear a word you're saying, the excessive burden weighing on her. You look into her eyes and see only darkness.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: You must have protected a lot of people. You won't have to fight alone.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Let's talk properly when everything is over...
The power of the shackles surges from within you. It's an extension of your soul, a tendril of your spirit. But that indescribable obstacle has disappeared at some point, making way for you.
Without hesitation, you exhaust every bit of strength in your body, pouring everything you've got into it.
Until the ringing in your ears drowns out the thunderstorm. Until darkness obscures your vision.
